component: G1 motion-free MAX YOLO11n qualification and live camera tracker

observer.note: The deployment wrapper classified 53.325 of 53.685 seconds; this run did not perform a separate image inspection.

result.reason: Two opposite-order passes reproduced the KRSC plus direct-maxpool gain over the prior MAX path, but the candidate remained about 1.55x TensorRT by median.

remaining_uncertainty: The multi-service build phase includes cache materialization and export work, so it is not a pure Docker instruction execution time.
Image and layer reuse were not separately inspected; the builder exposed 20 cache layer records across two images but not unique new-versus-reused layer counts.
P95 latency varied by backend order enough that the 1.35x TensorRT tail gate is not yet stable.
The live camera check exercised MAX only; an optional TensorRT live control was canceled because an unrelated deployment held Wendy's global build lock.
The result demonstrates a reproducible improvement over the prior MAX path, not TensorRT performance parity.
